Container.Name: archivist
Container.Overview: Folio (nhentai) and Nexus (HentaiNexus) CBZ archivists in one container. One page with a tab for each, each with its own tags, login and settings, and one shared library folder with the counts shown at the top.
Container.Requires: Stop the separate folio-archivist and nexus-archivist containers before starting this one, so two copies are never downloading into the same library. Each app starts with fresh settings here; log in to Nexus again from its tab.

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: The one shared library folder for both apps. Folio files start with the gallery number, Nexus files start with HN.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Saved settings. Folio uses the folio subfolder, Nexus the nexus subfolder.

Config.Name: Logs
Config.Description: Status and log files (one subfolder per app)

Config.Name: LIBRARY_SPLIT
Config.Description: Split into folders of this many ids. 0 = flat. Used by both apps.

Config.Name: SLEEP_INTERVAL
Config.Description: Seconds to wait after a cycle. Used by both apps; use FOLIO_SLEEP_INTERVAL or NEXUS_SLEEP_INTERVAL for one.

Config.Name: FOLIO_NHENTAI_TAGS
Config.Description: Optional starting tags for Folio. Easier to use the chips on the Folio tab.

Config.Name: NEXUS_HN_TAGS
Config.Description: Optional starting filters for Nexus, separated by spaces: tag:uncensored -tag:unbirth. Easier to use the chips on the Nexus tab.

Config.Name: FOLIO_REQUEST_DELAY_MS
Config.Description: Folio: pause between requests, in ms.

Config.Name: NEXUS_REQUEST_DELAY_MS
Config.Description: Nexus: pause between page requests, in ms.
